{{PAGENAME}}, as well as the other variants ([[Dark brain]], [[Dark intestine]]), will randomly appear on newly delivered corpses. Obtained after progressing far enough through the [[Inquisitor]] quest-line.

==Quest==
[[Snake]] asks you to bring him a {{PAGENAME}} for his final ceremony.

This is requested by the Witch [[Clotho]] to heal [[Koukol]]'s curse.

The [[Inquisitor]] needs evidence for the presence of an occult in the [[town]] to convince the king of the inquisition's plans. For this he asks you to bring him one {{PAGENAME}}, one [[Dark brain]] and one [[Dark intestine]].
